properties.description:
Let the user perform every supported planning operation independently through reusable UI components.

Scope

• Implement every UI/MCP parity row using existing controls, targeted rework and approved shared additions.

• Use the reviewed V1-V4 layouts for task/input relationships, queue/state actions, evidence and review.

• Include create/delete, link/unlink, priorities, import/export and structured conflict/error handling.

• Implement schema/reflection-driven Node view and one view matching adapter over existing types/fields/relations.

• Reuse persisted graph-reference resolution and existing navigation; implement node revision comparison with shared controls. New URL UI is excluded.

• Compose shared Review tabs, Author readiness, grouped-feedback display/composer, single-column Checks hierarchy and shared selection/toolbar components. Integrate existing files/diff/Preview views without custom substitutes.

Success criteria

1. Every exposed planning tool operation has a tested, discoverable UI path; no routine operation requires Codex or hand-edited JSON.

2. UI and MCP use identical owning operation contracts and actor-specific restrictions.

3. No surface-specific form, selector, command menu, thread widget or graph renderer duplicates a reusable component.

4. Unselected panel is blank; keyboard/focus/draft behavior survives unrelated updates.

5. Node works for editable and read-only nodes; creator is a read-only relation. No schema-specific task screen duplicates the shared renderer.

6. Node and evidence navigation resolve deserialized graph links to the correct target/revision using existing contracts; missing/deleted targets are explicit. No new URL UI or external browser-entry acceptance requirement.

7. No/inline/side-by-side comparison handles fields and relations. Historical read-only selection never changes expectedRevision for live writes.

8. Review has Overview/Changes/Preview, Author readiness and Checks -> Reviewers/Runnables -> Mandatory/Optional. Four right-aligned Runnables tree-row actions operate highlights; no checkboxes, per-item play controls, duplicate outcome/action panels or URL strip.

9. Both new comments and replies use the same editable typed-row component with row removal, clear boundaries and bottom actions; top-level content spans available width and replies alone indent.

10. Changes exposes all/modified files and exact target/composed iteration diff, line-anchored feedback and Preview reuse; view switching preserves unrelated panel state.

11. Runnables is an ordinary nested row under Checks; the Overview inner splitter begins below the toolbar and every far-right view tool remains inside the toolbar spanning both subpanes.

Evidence

• UI/MCP parity acceptance matrix

• V1-V4 browser screenshots

• Independent user CRUD walkthrough
properties.title: Compose complete UI CRUD and review controls
